detail.longDescription: So I did it: I managed to build a Glitch-Soc instance in Docker using the official Glitch-Soc image. For a lot of folks on here that’s probably trivial, but for me that’s a pretty big deal. One thing of note is the previous image I was using (from linuxserver.io) didn’t spin up separate ‘www’ and ‘streaming’ containers—everything is handled under a single ‘www’. I’m guess the reason to run both is something to do with being able to load-balance on a bigger server? # MastoHost # SelfHosting # SelfHosted
